paragraphs: Rabbi Yose be-Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai: Rabbi ordained him, HaPoalim 85a. Every prostitute who hired herself for two hired him for four because of his beauty. He entrusted him to Rabbi Shimon bar Isi ben Lakonya, his mother’s brother. He sat in Rabbi’s academy. Later, after his death, they did not admit him into the cave of his father, Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Shimon. A heavenly voice came forth: it was not because they were greater than he, but because he had not undergone the cave’s suffering; see his entry. Rabbi Yose be-Rabbi Elazar said in Rabban Gamliel’s name: anyone with a craft resembles a fenced vineyard. Tosefta, Kiddushin, chapter 1; see Rabbi Yose above.
